name: Grit & Risk
description: How much do you agree with each statement?
framework: Perseverance and risk-tolerance constructs from public research literature. Items are original and do not reproduce any copyrighted scale.

items.prompt: When a goal takes months, I keep working on it.
Setbacks do not make me give up.
I finish what I start, even when it gets boring.
I often lose interest in projects after a few weeks.
If something becomes difficult, I usually switch to something easier.
I am willing to try a path that few people from my school have taken.
I would take a chance on a new field if the reward could be big.
Uncertainty about the future excites me more than it worries me.
I prefer a guaranteed small reward to a chance at a much bigger one.
I avoid decisions when I can't predict the outcome.
